purpose: profile identifiers in the live FDA feed
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN length(regexp_extract(product_description, '[0-9]{12,14}', 0)) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS run_digits,
         SUM(CASE WHEN length(regexp_extract(regexp_replace(product_description, '[ -]', ''), '[0-9]{12,14}', 0)) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS split_digits,
         MIN(report_date) AS date_example
       FROM recallfeeds.fda_food

purpose: profile identifiers in the live CPSC feed
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN upcs <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_upc, SUM(CASE WHEN models <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_models,

       FROM recallfeeds.cpsc_recalls

SELECT i.store_id, st.state, i.sku, i.lot_code, SUM(i.on_hand) AS on_hand
     FROM erp.inventory i JOIN erp.stores st ON st.store_id = i.store_id
     WHERE i.sku IN ('NW-100125') GROUP BY i.store_id, st.state, i.sku, i.lot_code

purpose: supplier ship notices x ERP for NW-100125
sql:
SELECT a.sku, a.lot_code, a.dc_state, SUM(a.units) AS shipped_units, MAX(p.name) AS supplier
     FROM supplier_portal.ship_notices a JOIN supplier_portal.suppliers p ON p.supplier_id = a.supplier_id
     JOIN erp.skus s ON s.sku = a.sku
     WHERE a.sku IN ('NW-100125') GROUP BY a.sku, a.lot_code, a.dc_state
